player_prompt.intro:
Wo ne Player {player_id} wɔ Connect Four.
Wo disc symbol: {symbol}.
Game board no wɔ {num_rows} safu ne {num_cols} column.
Players fa turns si wɔn disc mu baako wɔ column no mu (0 kosi {end_col}).
Onipa a edi kan a ɔbɛtɔ (ne nua) anan discs akyiri, ɔno na ɔdi nkunim.
Wo berɛ a wobɛyɛ move no, fa column number no wɔ squared brackets mu.
Sɛ nhwɛso: '[col 4]' anaa '[col 1]'.

board.board_notvisible_state: Agodi agodie no ntumi mma wɔn a wodi agorɔ no nhu.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Player {player_id}, Nhyehyɛɛ a ɛyɛ mmaa. Expected format: '[col x]'.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Odwumfo {player_id}, Adwuma a woyɛ no mfa. Column {col} no wɔ nsɛm mu.
invalid_move.already_full: Odwumfo {player_id}, Adwuma a woyɛ no mfa. Column {col} no akyɛ.

action.dropped_disk: Њia {player_id} ayɛ wɔn disk ({player_symbol}) mu ma wɔde no kɔɔ column {col}.

outcome.win: Ɔbɔadeɛ {player_id} di nkonim bere a ɔde anan bɔ ano!
outcome.draw: Agoru no baa awiei sɛ wɔantetew mu.
